deterministic_issue_discovered_from_froz.description: The parent contract simultaneously says candidate articles are parsed to select a matching body and that a zero-matching-article state remains without player-level target exposure. The qualified parser extracts player names, so parsing all candidates would cross the target empirical boundary even when no authority-bearing source body is selected. This is internally inconsistent before any Week 2 target observation.

frozen_clarification.pre_target_source_discovery: For successfully captured candidate article bodies, inspect only recognized official NFL team heading text using the already-frozen TEAM_HEADING_TO_ABBR mapping. Do not extract or retain player names, positions, emergency-QB annotations, list items, or other player-level content during this stage.
frozen_clarification.candidate_body_matching_rule: A raw body is a structural candidate when its recognized team-heading set contains every currently due cohort team. Require exactly one distinct raw-body SHA among structural candidates. Multiple distinct matching bodies fail closed before player parsing; zero matching bodies remain WAITING without player-level target exposure.
frozen_clarification.empirical_boundary_crossing: Only after exactly one structural raw body is selected may the already-qualified inactive article parser run on that body. The first invocation that extracts player-level rows from that selected real Week 2 body crosses the application empirical boundary and is canonical for that cohort key.
frozen_clarification.post_selection_parser_integrity: After boundary crossing, require the qualified parser to succeed and require all due teams in parsed rows. Any parser integrity failure or missing due team is canonical non-PASS evidence for that cohort and may not be rescued by same-version source substitution or a later article revision.
